newsitem.title: switzerland: Swiss franc starts easier on technical slide.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc starts easier on technical slide.

text.p: 0710 GMT - The Swiss franc opened slightly easier against the dollar and was set to continue the trend in a technical reaction to recent gains, dealers said.
Near-term dollar direction is 1.4550 francs, they added.
Trading volume in Zurich was thin and expected to remain so as banks were operating with reduced staff due to local holiday.
The frenc franc was marginally easier on speculation that Frenc president Chirac could soon announce an election.
Mark/swiss was very quiet and trading sideways.
* Dollar opens at 1.4490/4500 francs vs Friday's 1.4588/4593 * Mark opens unchanged at 85.11/13 centimes * French franc steady at 25.23/25 centimes vs 25.25/27
